jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York (Judge Paul Engelmayer)

headline: Architect of $40 Billion Crypto Collapse Receives 15 Years, or $7.3 Million in Losses per Day Served
deck: Judge Paul Engelmayer sentenced Terraform Labs co-founder Do Kwon in Manhattan after his August 2025 guilty plea over the TerraUSD and LUNA implosion.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Digital Assets Desk

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: 15-year federal prison sentence for a $40B market wipeout — approximately $7.3 million in investor losses per day of imprisonment.
street_crime_compare.street_equivalent: Stealing $1,800 from a retail cash register
street_crime_compare.street_sentence: 24 months prison — roughly $2.47 in losses per day served
